p: Named references publish as the character they resolve to: © ® ™ — → …
XML predefines five entity names. & < and > round-trip unchanged, because the escaper writes them back.
The other two resolve to characters that need no escaping in element content: " and '.
A bare & that is part of no reference is escaped the same way.
Numeric references resolve as well: decimal ©, hexadecimal ©, and an astral one 😀.
An unrecognized reference stays the literal text the author typed: &nosuchthing; and &copy with no semicolon.
Inside a code span the source spelling survives, because a span is never entity-parsed: © and &.
